text: Asma, daughter of Abu Bakr, entered upon the Messenger of Allah wearing thin clothes. The Messenger of Allah turned his attention from her. He said: O Asma, when a woman reaches the age of menstruation, it does not suit her that she displays her parts of body except this and this - and he pointed to his face and hands.
note: Narrated by Aisha, sunnah.com translation · Sahih (Al-Albani), see citation slide
